name: Neelibhringadi
subtitle: Indigo & Bhringraj Anti-Graying Oil
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A time-honoured recipe devoted to preserving your hair's natural depth and vitality. Neelibhringadi marries the darkening, pigment-protecting qualities of Indigo with the root-fortifying strength of Bhringraj. Steeped slowly in a rich base of hydrating Coconut oil and antioxidant-dense Amla, this traditional infusion cools the scalp, delays the onset of premature silvering, and nurtures a vibrant, youthful lustre.

ingredients.name: Indigo Leaves
ingredients.role: Naturally deepens hair tone and protects existing pigment

ingredients.name: Bhringraj
ingredients.role: Fortifies the roots and encourages robust, healthy growth

ingredients.name: Amla Fruit
ingredients.role: Provides a concentrated dose of Vitamin C to stave off oxidative stress

ingredients.name: Coconut Oil
ingredients.role: Cools the scalp and provides a deeply conditioning base

whyThisHerb: Indigo is traditionally celebrated in Ayurveda for its remarkable ability to maintain and deepen natural hair colour, while Bhringraj provides the foundational strength required to anchor each strand.

howToUse.title: Section
howToUse.description: Part your hair to expose the scalp, focusing particularly on areas where early grays are visible.

howToUse.title: Massage
howToUse.description: Gently massage the oil into the roots using your fingertips to stimulate circulation and absorption.

howToUse.title: Rest
howToUse.description: Leave the oil on for at least an hour, or overnight, to allow the herbs to deeply penetrate the follicles.

howToUse.title: Cleanse
howToUse.description: Wash thoroughly with a gentle herbal shampoo. Consistent weekly use is key to preserving natural pigment.
